summary: The 24-year-old professional dancer reflects on winning the spinoff series, the advice Karagach offered her ahead of season 35’s premiere and her first partnership with ‘Secret Lives of Mormon Wives’ husband Conner Leavitt: “I couldn't ask for a better partner.”
